name: 11590 · Westbury, NY
findings: ZIP 11590 (Westbury) has 239 nonprofit organizations. 139 of them (58%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 125 organizations.
Health care organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (46% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 11590 (Westbury) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
